name: comp-122
blurb: Social login buttons with brand-colored backgrounds (Google red, Facebook blue, X black, GitHub dark gray).
description: Four full-width buttons with brand-specific background colors and white text. Each has a hover state with darkened background.
use_when: Creating prominent social authentication with recognizable brand colors.
avoid_when: When brand colors conflict with your theme or when you need dark mode support.
a11y: Icons are aria-hidden. Text labels clearly identify each provider.
